import json
import os
import signal
import sys
import time

mode, nonce, backstop_text = sys.argv[1:4]
if mode not in ("default", "ignore-term") or float(backstop_text) != 12.0:
    raise SystemExit(2)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN if mode == "ignore-term" else signal.SIG_DFL)
expires = time.monotonic() + 12.0
print(json.dumps({"role":"holding-target", "pid":os.getpid(), "ppid":os.getppid(),
    "pgid":os.getpgrp(), "session_id":os.getsid(0), "nonce":nonce, "mode":mode,
    "term_handler_native":int(signal.getsignal(signal.SIGTERM)),
    "executable":os.readlink("/proc/self/exe"), "self_exit_backstop_seconds":12.0}), flush=True)
while time.monotonic() < expires:
    time.sleep(0.02)
raise SystemExit(0)

import json
import os
import sys

fd = int(sys.argv[1])
nonce = sys.argv[2]
stage = "arguments"
try:
    target = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
    stage = "setsid"
    os.setsid()
    stage = "readiness"
    message = json.dumps({"role":"bootstrap", "pid":os.getpid(), "ppid":os.getppid(),
        "pgid":os.getpgrp(), "session_id":os.getsid(0), "nonce":nonce,
        "executable":os.readlink("/proc/self/exe")}).encode() + b"\n"
    if len(message) > 512 or os.write(fd, message) != len(message):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid/incomplete bounded readiness write")
    os.close(fd)
    fd = -1
    stage = "exec"
    os.execve(target[0], target, os.environ.copy())
except BaseException as error:
    if fd >= 0:
        os.close(fd)
    detail = {"stage":stage, "type":type(error).__name__, "message":str(error)[:160]}
    os.write(2, ("WS116_BOOTSTRAP_ERROR " + json.dumps(detail) + "\n").encode())
    raise SystemExit(125 if stage == "exec" else 124)
